policy.title: Privacy & Usage Policy
intro: KAI is an AI-powered platform that helps you work with conversations, documents, images, and enterprise workflows.
This policy explains what information you can provide to KAI, how it may be used, and what you should avoid sharing.
You are responsible for making sure that anything you provide to KAI is appropriate, authorized, and follows your organization's policies.

sections.title: Information You Provide
sections.description: KAI may process information you provide through:
sections.note: Provide only the information needed to complete your task.

sections.title: File Uploads
sections.description: KAI supports file uploads for tasks such as analyzing, summarizing, comparing, extracting, and transforming information.
items: The file uses a supported format
The file is within the allowed size limit
You have permission to use the file
The file is relevant to your task
The file follows your organization's data-handling requirements
sections.note: KAI may reject files that are too large, unsupported, corrupted, malicious, or outside permitted limits.

sections.title: Image Uploads
sections.description: Images and screenshots can be used when supported by the selected KAI feature.
items: Remove unnecessary sensitive information where possible
Crop or blur sensitive details before uploading
Do not upload passwords, OTPs, API keys, access tokens, private security credentials, or unauthorized information

sections.title: Information You Should Not Share
sections.description: Do not provide sensitive information unless it is specifically required and authorized for an approved workflow.
sections.note: KAI does not require passwords, OTPs, or private security credentials for normal AI-assisted tasks.

sections.title: How KAI Uses Your Information
sections.description: KAI uses the information you provide to understand your request and perform the requested task.
items: Maintain relevant context during an interaction
sections.note: How information is handled may depend on the feature, product configuration, organizational policies, and applicable data-retention requirements.

sections.title: AI-Generated Content
sections.description: KAI uses AI to generate responses, suggestions, summaries, analysis, and other content.
items: AI-generated content may sometimes be incomplete
AI-generated content may be based on an incorrect interpretation of provided information
sections.note: Always review important outputs before using them, especially for business-critical decisions. Human and organizational review should be used wherever required.

sections.title: Responsible Use
sections.description: KAI should only be used for authorized and responsible purposes.
items: Access systems or information without authorization
sections.note: Requests that violate applicable restrictions may be limited or blocked.

sections.title: Access, Security & Data Handling
sections.description: Your access to KAI features may depend on your role, permissions, organizational settings, and security requirements.
items: Use approved workflows for sensitive information
Report suspected security issues through the appropriate support channel
sections.note: Do not attempt to bypass access restrictions. Important business records should be stored in the appropriate approved organizational system.

sections.title: Your Responsibilities
sections.description: When using KAI, you are responsible for:
items: Providing information you are authorized to use
Using KAI only for approved purposes
Completing required human review before important actions

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.description: This policy may be updated as KAI introduces new features, supported file types, AI capabilities, or security and privacy requirements.
sections.note: The Updated date at the top of this page shows when the policy was most recently revised.
